name: Koppen-Geiger Climate Types
description: Spatial aggregations of Koppen-geiger climate types. The spatial aggregation are performed over climate type categories from (raster) grid into (GIS vector) polygons. The climate type with most area intersection is assigned to the polygon.

content.Related Publication 1: Beck, H., Zimmermann, N., McVicar, T. et al. Present and future Köppen-Geiger climate classification maps at 1-km resolution. Sci Data 5, 180214 (2018). https://doi.org/10.1038/sdata.2018.214
